feature: queue wait backoff (exponential + jitter for capacity/conflict waiters; ORCH_WAIT_BACKOFF_MS / ORCH_WAIT_BACKOFF_MAX_MS) + OpenClaw version-gate diagnostics (runtime tui interface probe runs before the version gate; unverified versions fail closed carrying the probe result, node-pty presence and the last-verified version) + orch-adapt shim (dev-repo first, installed-copy fallback)

runs.host: caller-supplied unit (fakeunit; zero model calls — the queue mechanism is agent-agnostic)
evidence: board: 0/2 verified 1 waiting [B1▶ B2⏳] → 1/2 verified 1 waiting → 2/2 finalized success=true
runs.note: two independent blocks serialized through a single admitted window (ORCH_MAX_WINDOWS=1) with fast test backoff (60/150ms); the waiting block's state is visible on the board and clears exactly when capacity frees up

openclawProbe.probe: openclaw tui --help → exit 0, --local/--session/--message present; node-pty present
openclawProbe.gate: fail-closed with the probe result embedded (first cold probe run can report mismatch if the 30s timeout is exceeded; reran OK)
